classification: Noncanonical one-off forensic audit; historical enable generations are inferred, not hardware-verified.

export.query: SELECT toJSONString(tuple(toString(uuid),toString(timestamp),event,distinct_id,toString(person_id),properties.scopeKey,properties.$os,properties.$app_version,properties.ota_runtime_version,properties.ota_update_id,properties.ota_is_embedded,properties.enabled,properties.trigger,properties.reason,properties.stage,properties.source)) AS record FROM events WHERE timestamp >= '2026-10-17' AND timestamp < '2026-11-21' AND event IN ('Offline Board Toggled','Offline Board Download Started','Offline Board Download Completed','Offline Board Download Failed') AND {filters} AND notEmpty(properties.scopeKey) ORDER BY timestamp,uuid LIMIT 500

semantics: Request denominator is first observed enable per client+OS+scope until a disabled toggle, an explicit abandoned-removed/abandoned-signed-out/abandoned-disabled diagnostic, or another explicit request ID; duplicate enables are folded. An identified generation requires its matching request ID for terminal attribution; unkeyed legacy terminals cannot settle its replacement. History before 17 October is not available, so these are inferred observed generations, not a census of disabled-to-enabled transitions.
Seven days are anchored independently at the request or start timestamp. An event at exactly seven days is included, provided it precedes the overall exclusive observation boundary.

Started cohort credits the first completed event before the next start or explicit abandonment on the same identity/OS/scope. Request cohort permits restarts before completion within the same observed enable generation.
No-start has an observed enable but no captured start or terminal completion. It does not prove no work occurred: already-cached markers, consent, delivery and identity changes are unobserved.

Only explicit lifecycle state=failed is a confirmed request failure. Legacy Download Failed reports are attempt diagnostics; even unknown-exit, watermark regression and snapshot exhaustion are not terminal while paging remains possible.

All aggregate per-person and per-release results retain production/native namespace/OS/branch filters and project internal/test exclusions. No client, person, request or event identifiers are committed.
Release dimensions belong to the anchor event. A request may resume under another OTA; this is launch attribution, not proof one OTA ran for its whole lifetime.

failureSignatures.query: SELECT properties.reason AS reason, properties.stage AS stage, properties.$os AS os, properties.$app_version AS native_version, properties.ota_runtime_version AS runtime_version, properties.ota_update_id AS update_id, properties.ota_is_embedded AS embedded, multiIf(positionCaseInsensitive(properties.errorMessage, 'server returned HTTP 416') > 0, 'HTTP 416', position(properties.errorMessage, '无法解码原始数据') > 0, 'localized decode (Chinese)', position(properties.errorMessage, 'Decodieren der Rohdaten nicht möglich') > 0, 'localized decode (German)', positionCaseInsensitive(properties.errorMessage, 'cannot decode raw data') > 0, 'decode (English)', positionCaseInsensitive(properties.errorMessage, 'Connection reset') > 0, 'connection reset', positionCaseInsensitive(properties.errorMessage, 'Failed to connect to') > 0, 'failed to connect', positionCaseInsensitive(properties.errorMessage, 'Software caused connection abort') > 0, 'connection abort', position(properties.errorMessage, 'ENOENT') > 0, 'missing artifact file', position(properties.errorMessage, 'unable to open database:') > 0, 'artifact could not open', 'other') AS signature, count() AS events, min(timestamp) AS first_seen, max(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM events WHERE timestamp >= '2026-10-24' AND timestamp < '2026-11-21' AND event = 'Offline Board Download Failed' AND {filters} GROUP BY reason,stage,os,native_version,runtime_version,update_id,embedded,signature ORDER BY events DESC,reason,stage,os LIMIT 500
